name: Run Logistics
desc: Run fleet ship: no monthly supply use and no passive repair. Repairs cost Supplies at each Node.

name: Command Uplink
desc: A berth and a direct link for the Run's commander, fitted to the flagship of an all-drone Run fleet. The ship is no longer treated as automated. If it is lost, the uplink moves to the largest surviving drone.
short: Lets the player command this drone.
